entities.summary: The Al-Falah Mosque is a mosque in Orchard Road Planning Area, Singapore. It is located at the base of a commercial building. The mosque was officially opened by Ahmad Mattar on 25 January 1987. Like most mosques in Singapore, it is administered by the Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura.
